source_status: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
completion_definition: Completed means an initial curated cross-reference pass: the complete supplied English source unit and each retained target passage were read, and each pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean exhaustive coverage or independent specialist approval.

This verse connects knowing His righteousness with the righteous practitioner’s having been born of Him. The shared righteousness/practice comparison preserves the additional birth claim and does not resolve an unprinted pronoun identity.

target_verses.text: Children, let no one lead you astray. The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as He is righteous.

cross_references.destination_anchor_check: not performed; matching identity checked against the pinned saved record

verses.text: See what kind of love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God—and we are. For this reason the world does not know us, because it did not know Him.
verses.display_text: See what kind of love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God—and we are. For this reason the world does not know us, because it did not know Him.

verses.text: Beloved, we are children of God now, and what we will be has not yet been manifested. We know that when He is manifested we will be like Him, because we will see Him as He is.
verses.display_text: Beloved, we are children of God now, and what we will be has not yet been manifested. We know that when He is manifested we will be like Him, because we will see Him as He is.

verses.text: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as He is pure.
verses.display_text: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as He is pure.

verses.text: Everyone who practices sin also practices lawlessness, and sin is lawlessness.
verses.display_text: Everyone who practices sin also practices lawlessness, and sin is lawlessness.

verses.text: And you know that He was manifested to take away sins, and there is no sin in Him.
verses.display_text: And you know that He was manifested to take away sins, and there is no sin in Him.

verses.text: Everyone who abides in Him does not sin; everyone who sins has neither seen Him nor come to know Him.
verses.display_text: Everyone who abides in Him does not sin; everyone who sins has neither seen Him nor come to know Him.

verses.text: Children, let no one lead you astray. The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as He is righteous.
verses.display_text: Children, let no one lead you astray. The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as He is righteous.

verses.text: The one who practices sin is from the devil, because the devil sins from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested: to undo the works of the devil.
verses.display_text: The one who practices sin is from the devil, because the devil sins from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested: to undo the works of the devil.

verses.text: Everyone who has been born of God does not practice sin, because His seed abides in him; and he cannot sin, because he has been born of God.
verses.display_text: Everyone who has been born of God does not practice sin, because His seed abides in him; and he cannot sin, because he has been born of God.

verses.text: By this the children of God and the children of the devil are evident: everyone who does not practice righteousness is not from God, nor is the one who does not love his brother.
verses.display_text: By this the children of God and the children of the devil are evident: everyone who does not practice righteousness is not from God, nor is the one who does not love his brother.

verses.text: For this is the message you heard from the beginning: that we should love one another,
verses.display_text: For this is the message you heard from the beginning: that we should love one another,

verses.text: not as Cain, who was from the evil one and slaughtered his brother. And for what reason did he slaughter him? Because his own works were evil, but his brother’s were righteous.
verses.display_text: not as Cain, who was from the evil one and slaughtered his brother. And for what reason did he slaughter him? Because his own works were evil, but his brother’s were righteous.

verses.text: And do not be surprised, brothers, if the world hates you.
verses.display_text: And do not be surprised, brothers, if the world hates you.

verses.text: We know that we have passed from death into life, because we love the brothers. The one who does not love abides in death.
verses.display_text: We know that we have passed from death into life, because we love the brothers. The one who does not love abides in death.

verses.text: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.
verses.display_text: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.

verses.text: By this we have come to know love: He laid down His life for us; and we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
verses.display_text: By this we have come to know love: He laid down His life for us; and we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

verses.text: But whoever has this world’s goods and sees his brother in need and closes his heart against him, how does the love of God abide in him?
verses.display_text: But whoever has this world’s goods and sees his brother in need and closes his heart against him, how does the love of God abide in him?

verses.text: Little children, let us not love in word or with the tongue, but in deed and truth.
verses.display_text: Little children, let us not love in word or with the tongue, but in deed and truth.

verses.text: And by this we will know that we are from the truth, and we will reassure our heart before Him,
verses.display_text: And by this we will know that we are from the truth, and we will reassure our heart before Him,

verses.text: whenever our heart condemns us, because God is greater than our heart and knows all things.
verses.display_text: whenever our heart condemns us, because God is greater than our heart and knows all things.

verses.text: Beloved, if our heart does not condemn us, we have confidence toward God,
verses.display_text: Beloved, if our heart does not condemn us, we have confidence toward God,

verses.text: and whatever we ask we receive from Him, because we keep His commandments and do what is pleasing before Him.
verses.display_text: and whatever we ask we receive from Him, because we keep His commandments and do what is pleasing before Him.

verses.text: And this is His commandment: that we believe in the name of His Son Jesus Christ and love one another, just as He gave us a commandment.
verses.display_text: And this is His commandment: that we believe in the name of His Son Jesus Christ and love one another, just as He gave us a commandment.

verses.text: And the one who keeps His commandments abides in Him, and He in that person. And by this we know that He abides in us: by the Spirit whom He gave us.
verses.display_text: And the one who keeps His commandments abides in Him, and He in that person. And by this we know that He abides in us: by the Spirit whom He gave us.

verses.text: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
verses.display_text: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

verses.text: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesses Jesus Christ as having come in the flesh is from God,
verses.display_text: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesses Jesus Christ as having come in the flesh is from God,

verses.text: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. And this is the spirit of the antichrist, which you heard was coming and is already in the world now.
verses.display_text: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. And this is the spirit of the antichrist, which you heard was coming and is already in the world now.

verses.text: You are from God, little children, and have overcome them, because He who is in you is greater than he who is in the world.
verses.display_text: You are from God, little children, and have overcome them, because He who is in you is greater than he who is in the world.

verses.text: They are from the world; for this reason they speak from the world, and the world listens to them.
verses.display_text: They are from the world; for this reason they speak from the world, and the world listens to them.

verses.text: We are from God. The one who knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth and the spirit of error.
verses.display_text: We are from God. The one who knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth and the spirit of error.

verses.text: Beloved, let us love one another, because love is from God, and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
verses.display_text: Beloved, let us love one another, because love is from God, and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

verses.text: The one who does not love has not come to know God, because God is love.
verses.display_text: The one who does not love has not come to know God, because God is love.

verses.text: In this the love of God was manifested among us: God has sent His only Son into the world so that we might live through Him.
verses.display_text: In this the love of God was manifested among us: God has sent His only Son into the world so that we might live through Him.

verses.text: In this is love: not that we have loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as propitiation for our sins.
verses.display_text: In this is love: not that we have loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as propitiation for our sins.

verses.text: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
verses.display_text: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

verses.text: No one has ever beheld God. If we love one another, God abides in us, and His love has been brought to completion in us.
verses.display_text: No one has ever beheld God. If we love one another, God abides in us, and His love has been brought to completion in us.

verses.text: By this we know that we abide in Him and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.
verses.display_text: By this we know that we abide in Him and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.

verses.text: And we have beheld and bear witness that the Father has sent the Son as Savior of the world.
verses.display_text: And we have beheld and bear witness that the Father has sent the Son as Savior of the world.

verses.text: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in that person, and that person in God.
verses.display_text: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in that person, and that person in God.

verses.text: And we have come to know and have believed the love that God has among us. God is love, and the one who abides in love abides in God, and God abides in that person.
verses.display_text: And we have come to know and have believed the love that God has among us. God is love, and the one who abides in love abides in God, and God abides in that person.

verses.text: In this love has been brought to completion with us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment: because just as He is, so are we in this world.
verses.display_text: In this love has been brought to completion with us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment: because just as He is, so are we in this world.

verses.text: There is no fear in love, but complete love casts fear out, because fear involves punishment, and the one who fears has not been brought to completion in love.
verses.display_text: There is no fear in love, but complete love casts fear out, because fear involves punishment, and the one who fears has not been brought to completion in love.

verses.text: We love because He first loved us.
verses.display_text: We love because He first loved us.

verses.text: If anyone says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar. For the one who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
verses.display_text: If anyone says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar. For the one who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.

verses.text: And this commandment we have from Him: the one who loves God must love his brother also.
verses.display_text: And this commandment we have from Him: the one who loves God must love his brother also.

verses.text: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the One who begot also loves the one begotten of Him.
verses.display_text: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the One who begot also loves the one begotten of Him.

verses.text: By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and do His commandments.
verses.display_text: By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and do His commandments.

verses.text: For this is the love of God: that we keep His commandments; and His commandments are not burdensome,
verses.display_text: For this is the love of God: that we keep His commandments; and His commandments are not burdensome,

verses.text: because everything born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
verses.display_text: because everything born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.

verses.text: And who is the one who overcomes the world except the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
verses.display_text: And who is the one who overcomes the world except the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

verses.text: This is He who came through water and blood, Jesus Christ—not in water only, but in water and in blood. And the Spirit is the one who bears witness, because the Spirit is the truth.
verses.display_text: This is He who came through water and blood, Jesus Christ—not in water only, but in water and in blood. And the Spirit is the one who bears witness, because the Spirit is the truth.

verses.text: For there are three who bear witness:
verses.display_text: For there are three who bear witness:

verses.text: the Spirit and the water and the blood, and the three agree as one.
verses.display_text: the Spirit and the water and the blood, and the three agree as one.

verses.text: If we receive human testimony, the testimony of God is greater, because this is God’s testimony: He has borne witness concerning His Son.
verses.display_text: If we receive human testimony, the testimony of God is greater, because this is God’s testimony: He has borne witness concerning His Son.

verses.text: The one who believes in the Son of God has the testimony within himself. The one who does not believe God has made Him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony God has borne concerning His Son.
verses.display_text: The one who believes in the Son of God has the testimony within himself. The one who does not believe God has made Him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony God has borne concerning His Son.

verses.text: And this is the testimony: God gave us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
verses.display_text: And this is the testimony: God gave us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.

verses.text: The one who has the Son has life; the one who does not have the Son of God does not have life.
verses.display_text: The one who has the Son has life; the one who does not have the Son of God does not have life.

verses.text: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
verses.display_text: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.

verses.text: And this is the confidence we have toward Him: if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
verses.display_text: And this is the confidence we have toward Him: if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.

verses.text: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we have the requests we have asked of Him.
verses.display_text: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we have the requests we have asked of Him.

verses.text: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he is to ask, and he will give him life—to those committing sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death; I am not saying that he should make a request concerning that.
verses.display_text: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he is to ask, and he will give him life—to those committing sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death; I am not saying that he should make a request concerning that.

verses.text: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.
verses.display_text: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.

verses.text: We know that everyone who has been born of God does not sin, but the one born of God keeps himself, and the evil one does not touch him.
verses.display_text: We know that everyone who has been born of God does not sin, but the one born of God keeps himself, and the evil one does not touch him.

verses.text: We know that we are from God, and the whole world lies in the evil one.
verses.display_text: We know that we are from God, and the whole world lies in the evil one.

verses.text: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding so that we may know the True One. And we are in the True One, in His Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
verses.display_text: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding so that we may know the True One. And we are in the True One, in His Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

verses.text: Little children, guard yourselves from idols.
verses.display_text: Little children, guard yourselves from idols.
